primary_sources.title: Adrien Dubouloz, Danielewski-Fieseler surfaces, arXiv math/0401225v3 (2004)
primary_sources.used_statement: Section2.8, printed/PDF page8: both directional affine-translation functions must have a pole for every pair of origins; this is an affineness iff criterion for the entire line-bundle torsor. Proposition2.6 and Section2.7 fix the weight and cocycle conventions.

primary_sources.title: Evelia R. Garcia Barroso and Arkadiusz Ploski, On the Milnor Formula in Arbitrary Characteristic, Springer (2018),119-133
primary_sources.used_statement: Proposition2.1(iii)-(iv), printed121-122/PDF3-4: conductor, derivative/Dedekind and c=2delta; Corollary3.4, printed128/PDF10: characteristic-zero polar identity for an arbitrary smooth coordinate l. Used for irreducible Gamma with l=y, not a positive-characteristic generalization.

primary_sources.title: Lisa Lokteva, Surgeries on Iterated Torus Knots Bounding Rational Homology 4-Balls, Proc. Edinburgh Math. Soc.66(2023),557-578, author version
primary_sources.used_statement: Proposition5, author printed8/PDF9: positive algebraic iterated cabling and characteristic recurrence. Proof of Proposition6, author printed10-11/PDF11-12, Figures3-4: resolution S3 graph, last curvette framing p_last*alpha_last, and surgery leaf N=n-p_last*alpha_last, converted to a negative-two chain. No rational homology ball classification imported. Proposition6 itself assumes n>=F+2; the distance-one case in the new note is proved by its own marked chain and cable-filling calculation, not imported from that proposition.

primary_sources.title: Walter Neumann, A calculus for plumbing applied to the topology of complex surface singularities and degenerating complex curves, Trans AMS268(1981),299-344
primary_sources.used_statement: Proposition2.1 R6 in both closed and punctured versions; Theorem6.1(III) linear-chain lens spaces. The already visually audited R6 has one remaining branch, zero removed punctures and no extra summands.

primary_sources.title: Tetsuya Ito, A Note on Chirally Cosmetic Surgery on Cable Knots, Canad.Math.Bull.64(2021),163-173
primary_sources.used_statement: Section2 printed165/PDF3, fully rendered and visually inspected: cable filling distance zero is reducible; distance one gives companion filling m/(n*winding^2); distance greater than one retains a two-exceptional-fiber Seifert JSJ piece. The source uses winding q, whereas the new note uses winding p.

visual_audit_scope: Complete cited criterion/formula pages rendered and visually inspected, including Lokteva Proposition5 on PDF9 and the full Figures3-4 argument on PDF11-12. No claim to have independently reproved the primary imports.
